thread:
elaine: Quick check — partner wants to hit our private health endpoint for their monitoring. They can only originate from 203.0.113.0/24. Can we temporarily allow inbound from that range to the VPC endpoint SG on 8443? Need to confirm logging/redaction requirements before I say yes.

samir: Which VPC endpoint exactly? the private API VPCE in prod-us-east-1?

elaine: yes prod-api-vpce (vpce-0a1b2c3d). Port 8443 (TLS). It’s only health pings (GET /hc). They asked for a 48h window but we can do 24h if that’s safer.

jess: Do we have any NACL or LB in front? If it's a VPCE with an SG we can add an ingress rule scoped to 203.0.113.0/24 on 8443 and tag it with "temp:partner-health". NACL would be broader.

ops-ryan: From ops side: fine with 24h. Two asks: (1) flow logs to s3 must have source IP redaction enabled (we should not store raw external IPs tied to request IDs), and (2) turn on detailed ALB access logs for the window.

elaine: Security question — is redaction config on the flow logs enough, or do we also need to strip IPs from app logs? Partner will be hitting the VPCE; nginx still logs remote_addr.

security-bot: Reminder: policy PRIV-LOG-03 requires removal or tokenization of external IPs from application logs for third-party probes unless approved by SecOps.

jess: We can add a nginx logfilter to mask remote_addr for requests to /hc. Simple lua or log_format tweak. Example I use locally: 

```
map $request_uri $masked_ip {
    default $remote_addr;
    ~^/hc$  "REDACTED-PARTNER";
}
log_format main '$masked_ip - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" $status $body_bytes_sent';
```

elaine: nice. ops-ryan, if we implement that + flow log redaction + ALB access logs, can you approve 24h window? Need to tell partner by EOD.

ops-ryan: Yep. Approve 24h from the time change goes in. I also want the SG change documented in the change ticket and rolled back automatically (or we delete the rule after 24h).

samir: I can apply the SG rule and add the terraform snippet below to the infra repo. Will tag the PR with "security-review" and request @security-team review.

infra-bot: Proposed TF diff:

```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "partner_health_inbound" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 8443
  to_port           = 8443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
  security_group_id = "sg-0f1e2d3c"
  description       = "temp: partner health checks — auto-delete after 24h"
  tags = { "temp" = "partner-health", "owner" = "elaine" }
}
```

security-bot: Add a change note to the ticket with the approval: "SecOps approves 24h conditional access if app logs are masked and flow logs redacted." Also attach the PR link.

elaine: I'll add the ticket and include the log filter snippet. Samir — please ping here when the rule is live and when you test the probe.

samir: Will do. ETA ~30m. I’ll include a rollback script that runs after 24h.

jess: FYI I’ll open a tiny PR to add the nginx mask rule; can merge once infra PR is ready.

infra-bot: Change scheduled: SG rule apply in staging at 2167900200, prod at 2167900400. Rollback scheduled at 2167986800 (24h).

ops-ryan: Adding monitoring alert: if we see >5k hits from 203.0.113.0/24 to /hc in the window escalate to oncall.

elaine: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll confirm with partner we can do 24h and they should throttle to 1req/sec. :thumbsup:

samir: SG applied to prod at 2167900425, quick health ping passed. Partner confirmed 200s. I’ll paste probe logs to the ticket in a sec.

security-bot: Log redaction check: flow logs configured with suffix "-redacted" and app logs show "REDACTED-PARTNER" for /hc entries. All good from SecOps POV.

elaine: closing the loop — thanks team. I’ll follow up if partner asks for extension.
